performance.verdict: Paid is fully dark; organic holding but GBP collapse demands immediate investigation.

findings.text: All paid spend is $0 for the entire 28-day window — Meta and Google both dark. Zero leads generated from paid channels.
GBP actions collapsed 98% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 26–28) show 0, 0, 0 vs a prior-week average of ~5/day — a confirmed signal, not noise.
Contract extension with Marwan is open and lapsed; no active paid engagement exists to optimize — this gates everything.
Search clicks rising (+4.4% 7d, 43 clicks on Aug 24 and Aug 26) while GBP craters — organic search holding without paid, but GHL shows 0 opportunities created from 24 contacts.
GA4 sessions up 14% 7d (76 sessions Aug 26) with 0 GHL conversions — intake pipeline shows a confirmed intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Investigate and resolve GBP listing issue immediately — 0 actions for 3 consecutive days vs 5/day prior.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for Aug 26–28, down 98% week-over-week from a prior average of ~5 actions/day. Log in to the Google Business Profile dashboard and check for a suspension notice, flagged content, or dropped ownership. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return to ≥5/day — re-check by 2026-09-01.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 24 contacts, 0 opportunities created — confirm Andrew's pipeline workflow is active.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day data shows 24 GHL contacts and 1,533 GA4 sessions but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — this is an intake process failure, not a traffic problem. suggestions.text: Watch for contract extension decision from Marwan — paid reactivation and all scaling actions are gated behind it.
